references.text: Describes the signs of Jesus' return and the end of the world, which are related to the questions the disciples ask in verse 3.
Explains that the timing of these events is unknown, which underscores the importance of the question the disciples ask.

Luke's parallel to Jesus' discourse on the end times, which also includes questions from the disciples about when these things will happen and what the sign of his return and the end of the world will be.
Mark's version of the Olivet Discourse, which contains similar questions from the disciples and Jesus' answer regarding the signs of the end times.
John's Revelation contains visions of the end times that can be seen as related to Jesus' descriptions in Matthew 24.
